---
title: "Update individual listings"
description: "Use Listings Manager in Card View to expand a product, edit price, stock, and lead time per variation, then save."
---

Open **Listings Manager**. The page title is **Listings Manager**; the description says you **manage prices, stock quantities, and lead time**.

Use **← Back to Dashboard** at the top or bottom when you are finished.

---

## Card View (default)

**Card View** is the default layout. Next to it, the toggle shows **Catalogue View**—see [Update multiple listings at once](/vendors/catalogue-view) for the table workflow.

---

## Find your product

Each **card** is one variable product (one parent listing). You see:

- The **product title** (often linked to the storefront listing).
- How many **variations** it has (for example “5 variations”).
- Status labels when applicable, such as **recently updated** or **invalid**.

---

## Expand variations

Use **Show Variations** to load and display every variation under that product. Use **Hide Variations** to collapse the card again.

When expanded, each variation row shows fields you can edit, including **Price**, **Stock**, and **Lead Time** (pick a value from the allowed list).

---

## Save or discard

If you change any values, a warning may appear: **You have unsaved changes. If you change views or reload the page, the changes will be lost.**

- **Discard Changes** — Abandon edits on this page load.
- **Save All Changes** — Opens a confirmation step. The dialog title is **Confirm Changes**; use **Cancel** or **Save Changes** in the dialog footer. If **Save All Changes** stays disabled, fix any invalid values the form highlights.

Before switching to **Catalogue View** or closing the tab, save or discard so you do not lose work.

---
